motion: The camera does not move. Heavy rain keeps falling across the night high street. The green and cream double-decker bus keeps driving steadily away from us down the long wet road, getting smaller and smaller, its lit top deck and red tail lights shrinking into the rain and the distance, until it is a small glow far down the street. Its reflections trail on the wet tarmac. The people keep walking slowly along the pavement. The shop signs stay exactly as they are. The camera does not move.
